prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production MATERIAL TEXTURE ATLAS for a cozy top-down pixel farming RPG. This is ONLY ground material, not a landscape scene, not icons. Original highly crafted classic 16-bit game pixel art. The user's reference aesthetic has lush detailed green grass with dense individual blade clusters, warm golden ochre dirt paths, and ragged organic soil transitions. Make material detail rich and tactile, not flat color fills with dots.
EXACTLY SIX opaque square texture panels in a strict THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, edge-to-edge, no gaps, no lines, no frames, no labels. Uniform cell dimensions. Each square must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE repeating material with equal visual density along all four edges, no border shading or central spotlight.
Row1 left-to-right:
1) lush healthy spring GRASS: a dense carpet of short distinct hand-pixelled grass blade tufts, layered deep forest-green shadows, emerald and warm lime highlights, uneven small clumps and occasional tiny clover leaf. Many tiny recognizable 2-4 pixel blades, organic subtle large-scale mottling. No flowers, no bare ground, no rocks. Rich saturated green, not a muted pastel.
2) GOLDEN PACKED EARTH walking path: warm sunny ochre / golden-yellow clay, tiny uneven dust marks, softly worn foot-worn patches, a few embedded small tan pebbles, delicate scuffs and fissures. Primarily warm golden #d8a44c to #f0c76a, medium detail, not beach sand dunes, not huge rocks, not uniform speckled noise.
3) DARK SOIL: rich warm sienna/brown loamy earth, crumbly tiny clods and subtle irregular wear, a few tiny buried stones, no plants, no straight farming furrows.
Row2 left-to-right:
4) village COBBLESTONE: small irregular worn warm grey stones with soft moss in tiny cracks, tightly packed, warm beige highlights and olive-grey shadows, no large regular square floor tiles.
5) shallow clear RIVER WATER: bright teal blue with delicate little pale cyan curved horizontal ripples and subtly visible pebbly riverbed, no shoreline, no white foam, no giant waves.
6) honey WOOD FLOOR: richly grained small horizontal timber planks, staggered joints, occasional tiny knots, warm honey-brown highlights with dark umber seams, worn smooth but detailed, no objects.
All six panels are PURE FLAT 90-degree overhead materials. No perspective, no 3D bevel, no cast shadows, no objects, no buildings, no trees, no text, no vignette, no gradients, no smooth photographic realism. Crisp recognizable square pixels with controlled local palettes (about 10-14 colors per material). Think each panel is originally hand-pixelled at 64x64 or 96x96 then sharply enlarged, with confident pixel clusters rather than fuzzy noise. This is a usable game texture atlas, must completely fill every panel and the entire output image.
note: Original opaque atlas copied unchanged. Runtime material sampling and organic masks preserve navigation grid.
